title: OpenShift DNS
text: OpenShift DNS resolves service names inside the cluster. Pods can use service DNS names for internal traffic.

title: Solace TLS
text: Solace PubSub clients validate TLS certificates using the hostname and SAN. If the SAN is my-solace.example.com, clients should connect with that hostname.

title: Route53 and NLB
text: Route53 can point a CNAME to an AWS Network Load Balancer. External clients reach services through the NLB.

title: TF-IDF and BM25
text: TF-IDF and BM25 are lexical search algorithms. They rank documents based on term frequency and document frequency.

title: Vector Search
text: Vector search uses embeddings and cosine similarity to find documents with similar meaning, even when exact words do not match.

title: Hybrid Search
text: Hybrid search combines lexical search such as BM25 with semantic vector search. It improves search relevance for many RAG systems.

title: RAG
text: Retrieval Augmented Generation retrieves relevant context from documents and sends it to a language model to answer questions.
